description: This file defines structures, function pointer types, and a vtable for TRACE2 target event handling, including event prototypes for versioning, start/exit, signals, errors, command tracing, child process events, threading, execution, parameters, repository info, regions, data, timers, and counters.

classes.name: tr2_tgt
classes.description: A vtable structure containing function pointers for various TRACE2 event types and lifecycle management.
